description: Feature #1685 stage 1 (#1704), probe P-B for light direction held within a scene. Three FLUX 3 Klein text-to-image cards of June in one living room at 1344x768: a wide (`wide`), a medium (`medium`) and a close-up (`close`), all on the job's one seed. The defaults are the control arm ('Warm practical light.'); the treatment arm passes the three prompts with 'Key light from frame left, warm practical.' in its place. Record: bench/records/continuity-grammar.md.

variables.prompt_wide: A cinematic wide shot of a small living room at night, a low coffee table and a bookshelf around her. June, a woman in her thirties with short black hair and a dark green sweater sits in an armchair reading a paperback book, her face toward the camera. Warm practical light. Photographic, 35mm film still, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field.
variables.prompt_medium: A cinematic medium shot of June, a woman in her thirties with short black hair and a dark green sweater, sitting in an armchair in a small living room at night, a low coffee table and a bookshelf around her, reading a paperback book, her face toward the camera. Warm practical light. Photographic, 35mm film still, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field.
variables.prompt_close: A cinematic close-up of the face of June, a woman in her thirties with short black hair and a dark green sweater, in an armchair in a small living room at night, a low coffee table and a bookshelf around her, looking down at a paperback book, her face toward the camera. Warm practical light. Photographic, 35mm film still, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field.
